verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and coding agent, not equity-management software. It does not hold a company's cap table or transaction ledger, so exporting that ownership data is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships cap-table management. Its generic ability to 'create files' is unrelated to exporting ownership records it holds, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
